verifiedBehavior: Versioned custom packs extend names, ancestries, tables, table extensions, archetypes, operation modules, mechanical packages, and level guidance without editing the generation core.
Protected IDs, missing dependencies, incompatible versions, unresolved references, malformed chronology, unsafe overrides, and invalid mechanics produce actionable diagnostics.
Rejected packs and incompatible upgrades leave the base runtime and installed-pack storage unchanged.
Depended-on packs can upgrade transactionally while downgrades below dependent minimum versions are rejected.
Quick, Standard, and Deep custom-archetype profiles remain deterministic and record base/custom pack provenance.
The browser bootstrap waits for all core data enrichers before snapshotting and applying installed campaign packs.
notes: The canonical NPC profile schema directly permits generator.customPackIds.
The original Kaysender runtime remains unchanged.
